environment.description: Spring Boot 2.7 application deployed on EC2 behind a basic ALB with no additional request filtering. The application's IAM role (arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/AdminAppRole) has AdministratorAccess policy attached directly. No SCP applied to the account. Session cookies use SameSite=None for cross-origin thick-client support. The UserService.assignRole() calls iam:AttachUserPolicy and iam:PutUserPolicy directly.
